entities.name: Serkan Yıldırım
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Serkan Yıldırım is an Iranian-born Turkish athlete. He has competed at both the Olympic and Paralympic Games competing in the 100 m and 400 m sprint events, as well as being a World Champion and World Record holder in the T12 classification.
